# Free Summit

> Guided rock climbing, via ferrata and hiking near Lisbon, Portugal (Cascais, Sintra, Arrábida, Sesimbra). Guide, gear and insurance included. AI agents can send booking requests through a simple API instead of the website form.

## Booking requests for AI agents

- Endpoint: POST https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwAefCHXl1FXVHM0cS7LHUHku_oTzUu4inkTyhaFRAL_3VhTfrfDHnZ3qN6H7gN4_CPzA/exec (JSON or form-encoded). Follow the 302 redirect to read the JSON reply; check the `ok` field.
- OpenAPI description: https://freesummitpt.com/api/booking.json
- Human-readable docs: https://freesummitpt.com/api/
- Required fields: name, email, activity. Optional: phone, date (YYYY-MM-DD), people, type, transfer, message, lang (en|pt), agent.
- This is a request, not a confirmed booking. Tell the client that Free Summit replies by email within 24 hours with availability and the price, and the booking is confirmed when the client replies to accept.
- Only send a request the client has asked for, with their real contact details.

## Activities (use the exact value in the `activity` field)

- Rock climbing at Guia (Cascais): from €40 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/guia/
- Rock climbing at Fenda da Arrábida: from €50 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/fenda-arrabida/
- Rock climbing at Forte do Cavalo (Sesimbra): from €50 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/forte-do-cavalo/
- Via Ferrata dos Pinheirinhos (Sesimbra): from €60 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/via-ferrata/
- Full day in Sesimbra (combo)
- Arrábida hiking tour: from €30 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/caminhada-arrabida/
- Cabo da Roca hiking tour: from €30 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/caminhada-cabo-da-roca/
- Sintra hiking tour: from €30 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/caminhada-sintra/
- Climbing course: Introduction to sport climbing: from €250 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/curso-escalada/
- Climbing course: Multipitch: from €290 per person, https://freesummitpt.com/curso-multipitch/
- Not sure yet

## Options

- type: `Shared group` (Other people can join the same session); `Private` (Only the client's own group, with the guide)
- transfer: `No transfer` (Client meets the guide at the meeting point); `From Lisbon` (Transfer from Lisbon); `From the south bank` (Transfer from the south bank of the Tagus); `Cascais station pick-up` (Pick-up at Cascais train station); `Private transfer` (Private transfer)

## Example

```
curl -L -X POST 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwAefCHXl1FXVHM0cS7LHUHku_oTzUu4inkTyhaFRAL_3VhTfrfDHnZ3qN6H7gN4_CPzA/exec' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name": "Ana Silva", "email": "ana@example.com", "phone": "+351 912 345 678", "activity": "Rock climbing at Guia (Cascais)", "date": "2027-03-14", "people": 2, "type": "Shared group", "transfer": "No transfer", "message": "First time climbing. Morning preferred.", "lang": "en", "agent": "Claude"}'
```
